user_direction: Нарезайте на задачи и работайте до завершения полного
immutability_rule: The approved solution bodies and acceptance criteria remain unchanged. Later edits may update project status and links or append approval, history, and stable criterion mappings. A changed decision or criterion requires a separately approved ADR.

project_status_mapping.accepted: independently verified and complete in the declared scope
project_status_mapping.rejected: replaced by an approved decision with retained rationale

role_separation.architect: Owns ADR status/history, acceptance mapping, evidence review, personal execution of acceptance checks, and the only transition to accepted.
role_separation.implementer: Implements approved scope and prepares source-bound evidence; does not change approved solution or acceptance criteria and does not accept an ADR.

workflow_environment.reason: The workflow package was cloud-readable but its filesystem helper and templates were unavailable in this environment.
workflow_environment.coverage_claim: No exhaustive local skill scan is claimed. The known incompatible clarification/specification workflows were excluded from architect and implementer handoffs.
workflow_environment.repository_convention: Existing architecture/streaming-etl paths and project status vocabulary take precedence over generic workflow paths and labels.
